body_markdown:
Meet us on the boardwalk for the NJDV HIMSS 2026 Fall Conference, bringing together health IT visionaries from across New Jersey and the Delaware Valley. As regional providers accelerate their interoperability initiatives, eFax® is on hand to demonstrate how intelligent cloud-based document exchange keeps clinical workflows agile, secure, and fully compliant.


Visit the eFax® team at Booth #102 to discover how our secure digital communication tools automate high-volume referral and intake workflows. Designed for HIPAA compliance and effortless system integration, our platform helps care teams eliminate paper bottlenecks and accelerate patient transitions.
